title: One DJ. One secret signal.
text: The DJ sees a hidden target on a spectrum. Only their phone knows where it is.

title: Give an example, not a number.
text: The DJ writes a clue that belongs at that spot: Your wedding cake arrives frozen.

title: Tune in. Then talk it over.
text: Everyone saves a guess on their phone. Once guesses are in, the TV shows the needles. Debate and update your guesses.

scene.sub: All guesses visible. Target still hidden.

title: Reveal the signal.
text: Within 5 earns 4 points; within 10, 3; within 15, 2; within 25, 1. The DJ earns the rounded average of submitted guesses’ points.

title: Pass the headphones.
text: Everyone gets one turn as DJ. No timer: let the conversation breathe. Most points after the final broadcast wins.
